script.title: ANTS IN THE KITCHEN
script.scene_zh: 深夜廚房 · 通報除蟲
script.story_hook: Ants marched in after rain. Tonight I text my landlord.
script.intro_zh: 雨後螞蟻大軍進駐，今晚先傳訊給房東。
script.welcome_en: Today's topic is tiny guests called ants. Grab your vinegar!
script.welcome_zh: 今天的主題是螞蟻這種小客人。先準備白醋！
script.outro: Sixty lines about ants, and you understood them all. Impressive!
script.outro_zh: 六十句關於螞蟻的對話你全聽懂了。了不起！
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the pest-control phrases now.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟讀除蟲相關的句型。
script.char_a_description: a cheerful college-age woman with long black hair in two braids, a slim build, wearing an apricot hoodie with a kangaroo pocket, black leggings, and fuzzy slipper boots
script.char_b_description: a lanky senior man in his sixties with wispy white hair and thick bushy eyebrows, wearing a brown plaid vest over a denim shirt, corduroy pants, and quilted house slippers

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, Hank? Sorry to text so late.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ hæŋk ˈsɑri tə tɛkst soʊ leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，漢克？很抱歉這麼晚傳訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem. Everything okay over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ˈɛvriθɪŋ oʊˈkeɪ ˈoʊvɚ ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題。你那邊一切都好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well... my kitchen has ants. Like, armies.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl maɪ ˈkɪtʃɪn hæz ænts laɪk ˈɑrmiz/
dialogue.zh: 呃……我廚房有螞蟻，像軍隊那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ugh. Tiny black ones, or the big red?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌɡ ˈtaɪni blæk wʌnz ɔr ðə bɪɡ rɛd/
dialogue.zh: 噢。是小小的黑蟻，還是大的紅蟻？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Super tiny. They march along the counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsupɚ ˈtaɪni ðeɪ mɑrtʃ əˈlɔŋ ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 超級小，沿著流理台列隊前進。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic sugar ants. How long have they been there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk ˈʃʊɡɚ ænts haʊ lɔŋ hæv ðeɪ bɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 典型的糖蟻。牠們來了多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Since Tuesday, right after the rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪns ˈtuzdeɪ raɪt ˈæftɚ ðə reɪn/
dialogue.zh: 從星期二開始，正好下過雨之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Makes sense. Rain pushes them indoors.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪks sɛns reɪn ˈpʊʃɪz ðɛm ɪnˈdɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 合理。雨水會把它們趕進屋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. So what do I do tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt soʊ wʌt du aɪ du təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 真棒。那今晚我該做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First rule: don't spray them, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɚst rul doʊnt spreɪ ðɛm pliz/
dialogue.zh: 第一條規則：千萬別噴殺蟲劑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't have spray anyway. Why not?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ dont hæv spreɪ ˈɛniˌweɪ waɪ nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 我本來也沒有噴劑。為什麼不能噴？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Spray scatters them into the walls.
dialogue.phonetic: /spreɪ ˈskætɚz ðɛm ˈɪntə ðə wɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 一噴，牠們就四散鑽進牆裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow. Good thing I asked first.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ɡʊd θɪŋ aɪ æskt fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 哇，還好我先問了你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move. Wipe counters with vinegar water.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muː waɪp ˈkaʊntɚz wɪð ˈvɪnɪɡɚ ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 明智之舉。用稀釋白醋擦流理台。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have vinegar! Red wine kind, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ˈvɪnɪɡɚ rɛd waɪnd kaɪnd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我有醋！不過是紅酒醋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. One part vinegar, two parts water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɚfɪkt wʌn pɑrt ˈvɪnɪɡɚ tu pɑrts ˈwɔtɚ/
dialogue.zh: 正好。一份醋，兩份水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done. Everything smells like salad dressing.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ smɛlz laɪk ˈsæləd ˈdrɛsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 擦好了。整間聞起來像沙拉醬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Temporary glory. Any crumbs tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈtɛmpəˌrɛri ˈɡlɔri ˈɛni krumz təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈！先爽一下。今晚有餅乾屑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll be honest, dishes sat all day.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl bi ˈɑnɪst ˈdɪʃɪz sæt ɔl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，碗盤泡了一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No judgment. Clean dishes, clean counters.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ dʒʌdʒmənt klin ˈdɪʃɪz klin ˈkaʊntɚz/
dialogue.zh: 不批評。碗盤乾淨，檯面就乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Food in the fridge now. Everything's in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /fud ɪn ðə frɪdʒ naʊ ˈɛvriθɪz ɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 食物全收進冰箱，外面一點不留。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's ninety percent of the battle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈnaɪnti pɚˈsɛnt əv ðə ˈbætəl/
dialogue.zh: 這就打贏九成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the other ten percent?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ði ˈʌðɚ tɛn pɚˈsɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 那剩下的一成呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pest control. I'll book Tuesday's visit.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛst kənˈtroʊl aɪl bʊk ˈtuzdeɪz ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 請除蟲公司，我預約週二來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that... my cost or yours?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt maɪ kɔst ɔr jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 那個……是我出錢還是你出？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the lease. Hold on.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə lis hoʊld ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下租約，稍等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No rush. I'll watch the ants think.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rʌʃ aɪl wɑtʃ ði ænts θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 不急，我剛好觀察螞蟻開會。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page eight. Landlord covers the first treatment.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪʤ eɪt ˈlændˌlɔrd ˈkʌvɚz ðə fɚst ˈtritmənt/
dialogue.zh: 第八頁，第一次除蟲處理由房東負擔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, that's a relief, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðæts ə rɪˈlif ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 噢，老實說我鬆了口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow-ups, though, fall on tenants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ʌps ðoʊ fɔl ɑn ˈtɛnənts/
dialogue.zh: 不過之後的追蹤處理，就由房客負責。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Prevention is my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf priˈvɛnʃən ɪz maɪ dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 很公道，預防是我的工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. You've basically done the prep already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli jʊz ˈbeɪsɪkli dʌn ðə prɛp ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，你其實已經做完前置作業了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to empty the cabinets?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tə ˈɛmpti ðə ˈkæbənɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我需要把櫥櫃清空嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, top shelves only, and cover the dishes.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tɑp ʃɛlvz ˈoʊnli ænd ˈkʌvɚ ðə ˈdɪʃɪz/
dialogue.zh: 要，只要上層，碗盤記得蓋起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do they stay closed?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ du ðeɪ steɪ kloʊzd/
dialogue.zh: 處理後要關多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four hours, then wipe the shelves down.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈaʊɚz ðɛn waɪp ðə ʃɛlvz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 四小時，之後再把層架擦一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my cat be in the kitchen?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn maɪ kæt bi ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
dialogue.zh: 當天貓可以待在廚房嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Absolutely not. Her bowls go out, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæbsəˌlutli nɑt hɪr baʊlz ɡoʊ aʊt tuː/
dialogue.zh: 絕對不行。牠的碗也要收走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. Bedroom floor for Mochi, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt ˈbɛdˌrum flɔr fɔr ˈmoʊtʃi ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 了解，那麻糬就委屈睡臥室地板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poor Mochi. What's the weather on Tuesday?
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊr ˈmoʊtʃi wʌts ðə ˈwɛðɚ ɑn ˈtuzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可憐的麻糬。週二天氣怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll check... sunny, supposedly. Perfect, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tʃɛk ˈsʌni səˈpoʊzɪbli ˈpɚfɪkt raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……說是大晴天，完美吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Supposedly. Rain cancels their outdoor spraying.
dialogue.phonetic: /səˈpoʊzɪbli reɪn ˈkænsəlz ðɛr ˈaʊtˌdɔr ˈspreɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 說是這樣。下雨他們就不噴室外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait. Do they spray the outside too?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt du ðeɪ spreɪ ði ˈaʊtˌsaɪd tuː/
dialogue.zh: 等等，他們也會噴外面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always. A barrier, so fewer get in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlˌweɪz ə ˈbæriɪr soʊ ˈfjuɚ ɡɛt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 一定噴，形成防護帶，進來就少了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds almost fancy for this building.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ˈɔlˌmoʊst ˈfænsi fɚ ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對這棟老樓來說，還挺高級的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, we try. Did you seal the trash?
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ wi traɪ dɪd ju sil ðə træʃ/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，我們很努力。垃圾桶蓋起來了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lid's on. Did that matter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪdz ɑn dɪd ðæt ˈmætɚ/
dialogue.zh: 蓋好了。這個很重要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Huge. Open cans are five-star ant restaurants.
dialogue.phonetic: /hjuːd ˈoʊpən kænz ɑr ˌfaɪvˈstɑr ænt ˈrɛstəˌrɑnts/
dialogue.zh: 超重要，沒蓋的垃圾桶是螞蟻的五星餐廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Noted forever. Um, how will he get in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtɪd fɚˈɛvɚ ʌm haʊ wɪl hi ɡɛt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 銘記於心。呃，師傅怎麼進門？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You don't have to be home, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dont hæv tə bi hoʊm ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實你那天不在家也行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh! So the tech uses a key?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ soʊ ðə tɛk ˈjuzɪz ə kiː/
dialogue.zh: 噢！所以師傅要用鑰匙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lockbox on the pipe rail, code by text.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɑkbɑks ɑn ðə paɪp reɪl koʊd baɪ tɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 管欄上有密碼鎖盒，密碼我會傳訊給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. And I'll get a photo report?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ænd aɪl ɡɛt ə ˈfoʊtoʊ rɪˈpɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 好。然後我會收到照片報告？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same day, straight to your email.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm deɪ streɪt tə jɔr ˈiməɪl/
dialogue.zh: 當天就直接寄到你信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is weirdly organized for bugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ˈwɪrdli ˈɔrɡəˌnaɪzd fɚ bʌɡz/
dialogue.zh: 對付蟲子居然有條有理，真怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bugs deserve paperwork. I'll confirm Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌɡz dɪˈzɜrv ˈpeɪpɚˌwɜrk aɪl kənˈfɜrm ˈtuzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 蟲子也值得走流程。我確認週二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, Hank. You're very calm about ants.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju hæŋk jʊrz ˈvɛri kɑm əˈbaʊt ænts/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你，漢克。你對螞蟻真的好從容。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve years of practice, my friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv jɪrz əv ˈpræktɪs maɪ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 畢竟練了十二年啦，我的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, salad-dressing kitchen, see you Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈsæləd ˈdrɛsɪŋ ˈkɪtʃɪn si ju ˈtuzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，滿屋沙拉醬味的廚房，週二見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night, Bea. Don't feed the ants cookies.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt biː doʊnt fid ði ænts ˈkʊkiz/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，小碧。別餵螞蟻餅乾啊。

You will hear:
・ pest vocabulary in casual texting English
・ who pays for what under the lease
・ friendly landlord-tenant small talk

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.
